headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office Following Degree Revocation
seoTitle: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns After Degree Revocation
metaDescription: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has resigned as Vice President after the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education revoked his educational diploma equivalence.
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education has officially revoked the diploma equivalence certificate issued to Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Following the ministry's administrative decision, Gibran Rakabuming Raka announced his resignation from the position of Vice President.
The government has requested that pending proceedings at the State Administrative Court regarding the degree validity be discontinued.
aiContextParagraph: On November 12, 2026, the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education officially revoked the diploma equivalence certificate of Gibran Rakabuming Raka. This administrative action followed legal developments involving both the Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court. Subsequently, Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally resigned from his role as Vice President on the same day. Legal representatives have indicated that the ministry expects ongoing litigation at the State Administrative Court (PTUN) concerning the status of the documentation to be ceased in light of this revocation. The development coincides with broader ministry initiatives focused on the integration of national education and health policies. Public discourse surrounding the resignation has involved various stakeholders, including those who previously initiated legal challenges regarding the authenticity and verification process of the educational documents in question.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to high coverage velocity across five major Indonesian outlets, driven by the significant political shift resulting from a high-profile resignation.
